extreme_conditions.description: At multi-kilogauss field strengths combined with Doppler speeds approaching tens of km/s, the Zeeman-shifted Fe I 6301/6302 profiles can overlap each other.
extreme_conditions.treatment: Both Fe transitions are synthesized simultaneously, so mutual overlap remains in the forward calculation.
